title: Parallel Circuit Execution for Scalable Quantum Computation
summary: Today's quantum processors have tens to hundreds of physical qubits, but reliable execution of arbitrary circuits remains limited to fewer than 30 entangled qubits across hardware modalities. Building upon prior work, we introduce an error- and topology-aware method for mapping multiple independent circuits onto disjoint regions of a single large-scale QPU for parallel circuit execution.
